subject.title: fix(cron): preserve script state and stop stale runs after restart

question: Does the maintainer want to accept the restart-recovery state contract that makes payload-script state the final successful writer when both trigger evaluation and the payload update shared state?
rationale: The patch intentionally defines durable ordering and restart semantics for persisted cron state; automated review can verify the implementation shape but cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Confirm payload state wins
options.body: Accept the proposed ordering and merge after normal final CI and maintainer review.

options.title: Keep trigger state authoritative
options.body: Request a narrower design that preserves trigger-evaluation state when both trigger and payload scripts modify it.

recommendation.title: Confirm payload state wins
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed ordering and merge after normal final CI and maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed execution and recovery contract is documented in the linked reports and implemented across the cron paths in this branch.
